model: Simple Glide Deluxe 750w Fat Tire Rear Motor
description:
The Simple Glide E-Trike — Now Upgraded Where It Matters Most

The Simple Glide E-Trike has always been built around one core idea: maximum comfort with maximum confidence. This upgraded version takes everything riders loved about the original and meaningfully improves it with new comfort technology, better adjustability, added utility, and premium safety features—all designed around real-world senior and mobility-focused needs.

Major New Upgrades You’ll Feel Immediately

One of the most important upgrades is the new rear dual suspension system. This enhancement dramatically reduces vibration and impact from cracks, bumps, and uneven terrain.

Softer, more cushioned ride quality

Less stress on hips, knees, and lower back

Greater comfort on longer rides and rougher paths

This upgrade alone transforms the riding experience, especially for riders with joint sensitivity, arthritis, or back issues.

The Simple Glide now features a vertically adjustable seat, allowing riders to move the seat up or down to find their ideal riding position.

Easier mounting and dismounting

Improved leg extension and pedaling comfort

Better posture and weight distribution

A more personalized, confidence-boosting fit

Paired with the recumbent seating position, armrests, and supportive backrest, this upgrade makes the Simple Glide more accessible to a wider range of riders than ever before.

The upgraded Simple Glide now includes a rear cargo basket, adding everyday practicality without compromising stability.

Groceries and errands

Personal items or medical supplies

Jackets, bags, or daily essentials

This turns the Simple Glide into a true mobility and utility vehicle, not just a recreational ride.

Premium Features Now Standard

Hydraulic Disc Brakes

The Simple Glide now comes standard with hydraulic disc brakes, delivering smoother, more controlled stopping with less hand effort—especially important for riders with limited grip strength.

Full-Color Display

A bright, easy-to-read color display provides clear ride information at a glance, including speed, battery level, assist mode, and trip data—no squinting, no guesswork.

Expanded Versatility & Accessories

Optional Canopy for Sun & Rain Protection

An available canopy (sold separately) adds protection from harsh sun and light rain, allowing you to ride more comfortably and more often—regardless of weather.

Integrated Hitch Attachment

The Simple Glide now includes a hitch attachment, giving you the ability to tow a trailer for:

Additional cargo

Passenger transport

Shopping, errands, or recreational use

This upgrade unlocks an entirely new level of flexibility and independence.

Still Powered by Trusted Simple Glide Performance

Smooth 750W rear-mounted motor

48V battery for reliable everyday range

Fat tires for enhanced stability

Recumbent design for relaxed, secure riding

Why This Is the Best Simple Glide Yet

This upgraded Simple Glide isn’t just about more features—it’s about better living on three wheels. Rear dual suspension, a height-adjustable seat, added cargo capacity, hydraulic braking, and expanded accessory options all work together to deliver:

More comfort. Better control. Greater independence.

For seniors, mobility-focused riders, and anyone who wants the smoothest, most accommodating Simple Glide ever built—this is the model that truly raises the bar.
